blocks.en: ■ Course Registration Change and Course Drop ▶ Course registration change (before classes start: 28 Aug 2026 (Fri) ~ 31 Aug 2026 (Mon) / after classes start: 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) ~ 7 Sep 2026 (Mon))
blocks.ko: ■ 수강신청 변경 및 취소 ▶ 수강신청 변경 (개강전 8. 28.(금) ~ 8. 31.(월) / 개강후 9. 1.(화) ~ 9. 7(월))

blocks.en: ○ Course registration change: during the period, students register for new courses and delete courses themselves on the course registration website (수강신청 사이트).
blocks.ko: ○ 수강신청 변경: 기간 내 수강신청 사이트에서 학생이 직접 교과목 신규 수강신청 및 교과목 삭제

blocks.en: ○ Registration for seats opened by cancellations (취소여석)
blocks.ko: ○ 취소여석 수강신청

blocks.en: - This applies only when you register for a course marked [취소여석] (seats available after cancellation).
blocks.ko: - [취소여석]이라는 표기가 있는 교과목 수강신청 시에만 해당

blocks.en: - You can register for seats opened by cancellations only during 3 set times each day (10:00~11:00, 13:00~14:00, 17:00~18:00). (Courses that have open seats but no 취소여석 mark can be registered at any time during 09:00~18:30.)
blocks.ko: - 1일 3회 지정 시간(10:00~11:00. 13:00~14:00, 17:00~18:00)에만 취소여석 수강신청 가능 (취소여석 표기 없이 여석 있는 교과목은 제한없이 09:00 ~18:30동안 신청)

blocks.en: ※ Only on the last day of the course registration change period (7 Sep 2026 (Mon)), registration closes at 24:00 (an extra time slot for seats opened by cancellations runs 20:00~21:00). ▶ Course drop (withdrawal)
blocks.ko: ※ 수강신청 변경기간 마지막날(9. 7. 월)에 한해 24시 종료(취소여석 시간 20:00~21:00 추가 운영) ▶ 수강신청 취소

blocks.en: ○ Course registration change period: during the period, students register for and delete courses themselves on the course registration website (no approval from the course instructor is needed).
blocks.ko: ○ 수강신청 변경기간: 기간 내 수강신청 사이트에서 학생이 직접 교과목 신청 및 삭제 (담당 교원 승인 불필요)

blocks.en: ○ Course drop period: the student submits a course drop request in mySNU, and then the course instructor approves it, or the course is dropped immediately.
blocks.ko: ○ 수강신청 취소기간: mySNU에서 학생이 수강신청 취소 신청-담당 교원 승인 or 즉시 취소

blocks.en: - Menu for course drop requests: mySNU > 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 수업 (Classes) > 정규학기수강신청취소 (Course Drop, Regular Semester)
blocks.ko: - 수강취소 신청 메뉴: mySNU > 학생서비스 > 수업/성적 > 수업 > 정규학기수강신청취소

blocks.en: - How to request a course drop: enter the reason for dropping in the course you want to drop > Save > Submit
blocks.ko: - 수강취소 신청방법: 취소희망 교과목에 취소사유 입력 > 저장 > 신청

blocks.en: 1) Courses that do not need instructor approval: the course is dropped immediately (cannot be restored).
blocks.ko: 1) 담당교원 승인이 불필요한 강좌: 즉시 취소(복구 불가)

blocks.en: 2) Courses that need instructor approval: after you submit the drop request, a notification is sent to the instructor by e-mail/SMS.
blocks.ko: 2) 담당교원 승인이 필요한 강좌: 취소 신청 완료 후 담당 교원에게 E-mail/SMS로 알림 송부됨

blocks.en: - The course drop is completed only if the instructor approves it within the period.
blocks.ko: - 기간 내 담당 교원이 수강취소 승인해야만 수강신청 취소 완료

blocks.en: ※ To check that your drop request is valid: after you submit it, the status should be '승인 대기' (Waiting for approval).
blocks.ko: ※ 수강신청 취소 신청이 유효한지 확인: 신청 후 상태 = ‘승인 대기’

blocks.en: ▶ Frequently Asked Questions (Course Drop)
blocks.ko: ▶ 자주 묻는 질문(수강신청 취소)

blocks.en: ○ My course drop has been completed. Can I take that course again?
blocks.ko: ○ 수강신청 취소 완료되었는데 다시 해당 교과목을 수강할 수 있나요?

blocks.en: ○ Once a course drop is completed, it cannot be reversed. (It can be reversed only before the instructor approves it. For courses that do not need approval, it cannot be reversed.)
blocks.ko: ○ 수강신청 취소 완료된 경우 취소를 번복할 수 없습니다. (담당 교원 승인 전까지만 번복 가능, 승인 필요 없는 강좌의 경우 번복 불가)

blocks.en: ■ Course Overlap Registration (중복수강신청, registering for courses whose class times overlap) ▶ Course overlap registration
blocks.ko: ■ 중복수강신청 ▶ 중복수강신청

blocks.en: ○ In principle, you cannot register for courses whose class times overlap. However, if you unavoidably need to take them, check the procedure below.
blocks.ko: ○ 원칙적으로 수업시간이 중복되도록 수강신청 할 수 없으나 부득이하게 수강해야 하는 경우 절차 확인

blocks.en: 1) Register for one of the courses with overlapping class times on the course registration website.
blocks.ko: 1) 수강신청 사이트를 통해 수업시간이 중복된 교과목 중 한 과목 수강신청

blocks.en: 2) Discuss this in advance with the instructor of the course you registered for in 1), and prepare supporting documents that show the instructor's approval.
blocks.ko: 2) 1)에서 수강신청한 교과목의 담당교원과 사전 협의 및 승인 증빙자료 준비

blocks.en: 3) Request overlap registration for the remaining course(s) in mySNU 중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request) (학사정보 (Academic Information) - 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) - 수업 (Classes) - 중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request)). * See the attached course overlap request manual. (Student request period) (2nd round) 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) ~ 9 Sep 2026 (Wed) (Instructor approval period) (2nd round) 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) ~ 10 Sep 2026 (Thu)
blocks.ko: 3) mySNU 중복수강신청(학사정보-수업/성적-수업-중복수강신청)에서 나머지 교과목 중복수강신청 * 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 별첨 참조 (학생 신청 기간) (2차) 9. 1.(화) ~ 9. 9.(수) (교원 승인 기간) (2차) 9. 1.(화) ~ 9. 10.(목)

blocks.en: - If you could not register for any of the courses on the course registration website, or if the course quota has been exceeded: first complete a quota-exceeding registration request, including approval and confirmation, and then also attach supporting documents (a screenshot of the confirmed quota-exceeding registration) when you submit your request.
blocks.ko: - 수강신청사이트에서 한 과목도 수강신청하지 못했거나 교과목 정원이 초과된 경우: 정원 외 신 청 승인 및 확정까지 완료한 후 증빙자료(정원 외 신청 확정화면 첨부) 신청시 추가 첨부

blocks.en: ※ You can check whether your request has been applied in mySNU 중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request).
blocks.ko: ※ mySNU 중복수강신청에서 반영여부 확인 가능

blocks.en: ▶ Frequently Asked Questions Q1) What should I do if three or more courses have overlapping class times? A1) You need overlap approval from the professors of all the overlapping courses (3 or more professors).
blocks.ko: ▶ 자주 묻는 질문 Q1) 수업시간 중복되는 과목이 세 과목 이상인 경우는 어떻게 하나요? A1) 중복되는 교과목 전체 교과목 교수님(3명 이상)의 중복수강승인이 필요합니다.

blocks.en: Q2) What should I do if I could not register for any of the overlapping courses and they are full? A2) If the courses stay full, you must get approval from the professors for both the course overlap and the quota-exceeding registration, and submit the proof (approval of the course overlap and the quota-exceeding registration) to the Academic Affairs Division (학사과).
blocks.ko: Q2) 중복되는 수업 모두 수강신청하지 못하고 정원이 마감된 경우엔 어떻게 하나요? A2) 정원이 계속 마감된 경우엔 교수님께 중복수강과 정원외신청을 함께 승인받고 학사과로 증빙(중복 수강 및 정원외신청 승인)을 제출해주셔야 합니다.

blocks.en: Q3) Is there a set form for the supporting document for quota-exceeding registration? A3) Any document that shows approval of the quota-exceeding registration is accepted. (The professor's e-mail / the record of instructor approval in the quota-exceeding registration menu of the course registration website)
blocks.ko: Q3) 정원외신청 증빙서류가 정해져 있나요? A3) 정원외신청 승인을 확인할 수 있는 서류라면 모두 가능합니다. (교수님 메일/수강신청 사이트 정원외신청-교원승인 내역)

blocks.en: ▶ Frequently Asked Questions (Quota-Exceeding Registration) Q1) Can I request quota-exceeding registration even if I have already used all my registration credits? A1) The credits you can request through quota-exceeding registration are 'credits allowed for registration - currently registered credits + 6 credits'. Even if you have used all your registration credits, you can request quota-exceeding registration for up to 6 credits and receive instructor approval.
blocks.ko: ▶ 자주 묻는 질문(정원외신청) Q1) 수강신청학점을 모두 채운 경우에도 정원외신청이 가능할까요? A1) 정원 외 신청을 신청할 수 있는 학점은 ‘수강신청가능학점-현재 수강신청된 학점 + 6학점’입니다. 수 강신청학점을 모두 채웠더라도 6학점까지 정원외신청을 신청하고 담당 교원 승인까지 받으실 수 있습니

blocks.en: However, before you confirm the registration, you must adjust the number of your credits through course registration change or course drop so that you do not go over your allowed registration credits.
blocks.ko: 다. 다만, 수강확정하기 전 수강신청 가능학점이 초과되지 않도록 수강신청 변경 혹은 수강신청 취소를 통해 수강학점 수를 조정해야 합니다.

blocks.en: Q2) Can I request quota-exceeding registration for a course whose class time overlaps with a course I have already registered for? A2) Even if the class times overlap, you can request quota-exceeding registration and receive instructor approval. However, when you confirm the registration, a course with overlapping class time will not be added to your registration. Therefore, before you confirm, you must free that class time through course registration change or course drop.
blocks.ko: Q2) 정원 외 신청할 교과목이 수강신청한 교과목과 수업시간이 중복되는 경우 정원외신청이 가능할까요? A2) 수업시간이 중복되는 경우에도 정원 외 신청을 신청하고 담당 교원 승인까지 받으실 수 있습니다. 다 만, 수강확정할 때에는 수업시간이 중복되면 수강신청에 반영되지 않기 때문에 수강확정 전까지 수강신청 변경 혹은 수강신청 취소를 통해 수업시간을 비워두어야 합니다.

blocks.en: Q3) Can I request quota-exceeding registration for a course that is an equivalent course (동일교과목) of a course I have already registered for? A3) If you request quota-exceeding registration for an equivalent course, it will not be added to your registration when you confirm. Therefore, before requesting quota-exceeding registration, you must check in the course details whether it is an equivalent course.
blocks.ko: Q3) 정원 외 신청할 교과목이 수강신청한 교과목과 동일교과목인 경우 정원외신청이 가능할까요? A3) 동일교과목을 정원외신청할 경우, 수강확정 시 동일교과목인 경우 수강신청에 반영되지 않기 때문에 정원외신청 전에 교과목 상세정보에서 동일교과목 여부를 반드시 확인해야 합니다.

blocks.en: Q4) Can I request quota-exceeding registration for several different class sections (분반) of the same course? A4) Even for different sections of the same course, you can submit the request and receive instructor approval. However, when you confirm the registration, you can confirm only 1 section of the same course.
blocks.ko: Q4) 같은 교과목의 분반이 다른 강좌를 여러 개 정원외신청할 수 있나요? A4) 동일한 교과목 분반이 다른 경우에도 신청-교원 승인까지는 가능합니다. 다만, 수강확정 시에는 동일 한 교과목은 분반 중 1개만 확정할 수 있습니다.

blocks.en: Q5) If my quota-exceeding registration request is rejected, or I cancel it before approval, can I make a new quota-exceeding registration request for the same number of credits? A5) If your quota-exceeding registration request is rejected or you cancel it before it is approved, you can request quota-exceeding registration again for that number of credits within the period.
blocks.ko: Q5) 정원외신청이 반려되거나 승인 전 신청취소한 경우, 해당 학점만큼 새로 정원외신청할 수 있나요? A5) 정원외신청이 반려되거나 승인되기 전 신청취소한 경우, 다시 그 학점만큼 기간 내 정원외신청을 다 시 신청할 수 있습니다.

blocks.en: Q6) I received instructor approval but did not confirm the registration within the period. Does that mean I cannot take the course? A6) If you do not confirm the registration within the period, the course will not be added to your registration record, even if the instructor has approved it. Please make sure to click 수강확정 (Confirm Registration) and check your registration record. ■ Notes on Course Registration
blocks.ko: Q6) 담당 교원 승인은 받았는데, 미처 기간 내 수강확정하지 못했는데 수강할 수 없게 되나요? A6) 기간 내 수강확정하지 못한 경우 담당 교원의 승인을 받았더라도 수강신청에 내역에 반영되지 않습 니다. 반드시 수강확정을 누르시고 수강신청 내역을 확인해주시기 바랍니다. ■ 수강신청 유의사항

blocks.en: Q1) Can I request for quota exceeding course registration even if available credits for course registration is full? (For example, I can register up to 18 credits) A1) Here is an equation for calculating credits for quota exceeding course registration.
blocks.ko: Q1) Can I request for quota exceeding course registration even if available credits for course registration is full? (For example, I can register up to 18 credits) A1) Here is an equation for calculating credits for quota exceeding course registration.

blocks.en: Credits for quota exceeding course registration = Available credits for course registration – Currently registered credits + 6 credits
blocks.ko: Credits for quota exceeding course registration = Available credits for course registration – Currently registered credits + 6 credits

blocks.en: In your case, you have 18 credits available for course registration and registered 18 credits, so you can request for quota exceeding course registration with 6 credits. You can request for quota exceeding course registration and get instructor’s approval. However, you can register total 18 credits for course registration. Therefore, you have to change or drop courses during course change period or course drop and adjust credits BEFORE you click ‘Registration confirmation’ in quota exceeding course registration menu.
blocks.ko: In your case, you have 18 credits available for course registration and registered 18 credits, so you can request for quota exceeding course registration with 6 credits. You can request for quota exceeding course registration and get instructor’s approval. However, you can register total 18 credits for course registration. Therefore, you have to change or drop courses during course change period or course drop and adjust credits BEFORE you click ‘Registration confirmation’ in quota exceeding course registration menu.

blocks.en: Q2) Would it be possible to request a course for quota exceeding course registration, if this course overlaps other registered course? A2) You can still request for quota exceeding course registration and get instructor’s approval even if the course will be overlapped with registered course. However, you need to change or drop courses and make sure class time is empty before you click ‘Registration Confirmation’. If not, you cannot confirm registration if there are any courses overlapping requested course.
blocks.ko: Q2) Would it be possible to request a course for quota exceeding course registration, if this course overlaps other registered course? A2) You can still request for quota exceeding course registration and get instructor’s approval even if the course will be overlapped with registered course. blocks.en: Q3) Would it be possible to request a course for quota exceeding course registration, if this course is same type of course according to Alternatives in Course Details of CRS? A3) You can request for quota exceeding course registration and get instructor’s approval even if the course is same type of course in Alternatives of Course details. blocks.en: Q4) Can I request for quota exceeding course registration with same course number and different lecture numbers? blocks.en: Guide to Choosing the Grading Option for Major Courses of Other Departments (Schools), 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
blocks.ko: 2026학년도 2학기 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제 안내

blocks.en: 1. Background
blocks.ko: 1. 도입 배경

blocks.en: 가. To give students more choice of major courses offered by other departments (schools), and to reduce the burden of registering for and getting grades in other majors' courses, which comes from differences in students' background knowledge
blocks.ko: 가. 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 선택권 확대 및 학생별 이해도 차이로 인한 타 전공 수강신청 및 성적 취득의 부담감 해소

blocks.en: 나. To give students the chance to grow into interdisciplinary (convergent) talents who explore many different fields of study
blocks.ko: 나. 다양한 분야의 학문을 탐구하는 융합형 인재로 성장할 수 있는 기회 제공

blocks.en: 2. Grading Option Choice for Major Courses of Other Departments (Schools) — Category / Details — Start date: 1st semester of the 2018 academic year — (Default setting) All undergraduate major courses (grading method change set to 'Yes') — Instructors/staff, Courses: (Not applied) If the option cannot be applied for unavoidable reasons, such as the nature of the course or the way the class is run, the course may be excluded by changing the grading method change setting to 'No' and stating the reason when requesting the course opening each semester.
blocks.ko: 2. 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제 구분 내용 도입시기 2018학년도 1학기 (기본 설정) 전체 학부 전공 교과목 (성적평가 방법 변경 ‘예’) 교수자/ 적용 (미적용) 교과목 특성 혹은 수업 운영 방식 등 부득이한 사유로 선택제를 직원 교과목 적용할 수 없는 경우, 매 학기 교과목 개설 요청 시 성적평가 방법 변경 ‘아니오’ 변경 및 관련 이유 기재하여 적용하지 않을 수 있음

blocks.en: Undergraduate students who take major courses of other departments (schools)
blocks.ko: 학사과정 학생 중 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목을 수강하는 학생

blocks.en: ○ Students who are completing a department's courses as their first major or as a multi-major (minor, double major, combined major, interdisciplinary major, student-designed major, convergence major, etc.) cannot choose the grading option for that department's (school's) courses. [Eligible students]
blocks.ko: ○ 주전공 및 다전공(부전공, 복수전공, 연합전공, 연계전공, 학생설계전공, 융합전공 등)이수 중인 경우, 해당 학과(부)의 교과목 성적평가방법 대상자 선택 불가

blocks.en: ○ Students who plan to enter a multi-major (minor, double major, combined major, interdisciplinary major, student-designed major, convergence major, etc.) and who, under its completion requirements, must complete the course as a 전선 (major elective) or 전필 (major requisite) should not choose the grading option for that department's (school's) courses.
blocks.ko: ○ 다전공(부전공, 복수전공, 연합전공, 연계전공, 학생설계전공, 융합전공 등) 진입 계획이 있는 경우 이수요건 상 반드시 전선/전필로 이수해야 하는 경우, 해당 학과(부)의 교과목 성적평가방법은 선택하지 않아야 함

blocks.en: Application period: 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) ~ 23 Sep 2026 (Wed) (from the first day of classes to the point when 1/4 of the class days have passed)

Students apply within the period (approval from the instructor is not required). Students ○ Menu: mySNU → 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 수업 (Classes) → 성적평가방법변경신청 (Grading Option Change Request). How to apply
blocks.ko: 학생이 기간 내 신청 (담당 교원 승인 불요) 학생 ○ 메뉴: mySNU → 학사정보 → 수업/성적 → 수업 → 성적평가방법변경신청 신청 방법

blocks.en: ○ Student request: letter grade (A~F) → pass/fail (S/U)
blocks.ko: ○ 학생 신청: 등급제(A~F) → 급락제(S/U)

blocks.en: ※ Some major courses whose grading method is pass/fail (S/U) can also be changed to letter grade (A~F)
blocks.ko: ※ 성적평가방법이 급락제(S/U)인 일부 전공 교과목도 등급제(A~F)로 변경 가능

blocks.en: ○ If a student does not apply, the course's original grading method applies.
blocks.ko: ○ 학생이 신청하지 않을 경우, 교과목의 성적평가방법이 그대로 적용됨

blocks.en: Credits: maximum 9 credits during the whole period of enrolment
blocks.ko: 신청 학점 재학 중 최대 9학점

blocks.en: Change of course classification: For courses in which an SNU student chose the grading option (A~F → S/U) and received an 'S' grade, the course classification cannot be changed (일선 (general elective) → 전선/전필 (major elective/major requisite)).
blocks.ko: 교과구분 본교생이 성적평가방법 선택(A~F→S/U)하여 ‘S’ 성적을 받은 교과목은 변경 교과구분 변경(일선→전선/전필) 불가

blocks.en: Retaking: A retaken course is completed with the grading method chosen when the course was first taken. Retaking: However, if a student received a U (fail) grade under pass/fail (S/U) the first time and then retakes the course as a course of their own major after being selected for a multi-major, changing majors, etc., the course is completed with letter grades (A~F).
blocks.ko: 처음 수강할 때 선택한 성적평가방법으로 재수강 재수강 단, 처음 수강할 때 급락제(S/U)로 U(낙제) 성적을 받고 다전공 선발, 전과 등으로 본인 전공 교과목으로 재수강하는 경우는 등급제(A~F)로 이수

blocks.en: ※ This is unrelated to the grading option choice for liberal arts courses (physical education and special liberal arts courses), which is run separately.
blocks.ko: ※ 교양 교과목 성적평가방법 선택(체육 및 특수 교양 교과목)과는 무관하며 별도로 운영

(Instructors and staff) Setting whether the option applies when opening a course (course opening): If the system is difficult to apply because of the course's nature or the way it is run, the course can be excluded by changing the grading method change setting to 'No' when opening the course and stating why the system is difficult to apply.

blocks.en: Course Overlap Request Manual (For Students) — 중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request): What is a Course Overlap Request?
blocks.ko: 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 (학생용) 중복수강신청 중복수강신청이란?

blocks.en: Overview: When you have no choice but to take 2 or more courses whose class times overlap, you may register for them together as an overlap, with the approval of the professor in charge.
blocks.ko: 개요 시간표가 겹치는 2개 이상의 과목을 부득이하게 동시 수강해야 하는 경우, 담당 교원의 승인을 얻어 중복으로 수강신청하는 제도

blocks.en: ※ You cannot register for all of these courses on the course registration website. A separate request and approval are needed. How to apply: ① First, complete course registration for 1 of the courses. ② Get permission* for the overlap request from the professor in charge of the course you registered for in ①. * Permission: can be proven with material that shows the professor's decision, such as an email. ③ Submit an online request for the other course on the mySNU '중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request)' screen.
blocks.ko: ※ 수강신청 사이트에서는 모든 과목에 대한 수강신청이 불가하며, 별도 신청 및 승인이 필요함 방법 ① 1개 과목에 대한 수강신청을 먼저 완료한 후, ② ①에서 수강신청한 과목의 담당 교원으로부터 중복수강신청 허가*를 받아서 * 허가: 이메일 등 담당 교원의 의사 확인이 가능한 자료로 증빙 가능 ③ mySNU ‘중복수강신청’화면에서 다른 교과목에 대해 전산 신청

blocks.en: Q) Can I request an overlap for 3 or more courses? A) Yes, you can apply. However, you must first register for 1 course, and then register for the remaining courses through the mySNU Course Overlap Request. In this case, approval from the professors of all the courses is needed.

english: The schedule for course registration changes and cancellations for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year is announced below. Please refer to the attached files for details.
1. Course registration change and cancellation period

※ For undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부) only, the 정원 외 신청 (over-enrollment request, i.e. a request to register for a course that is already full) period runs on a separate schedule*. Please make sure not to confuse the dates.
* Over-enrollment request period for undergraduate courses: 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) – 3 Sep 2026 (Thu) 18:00 (the deadline is strictly enforced)
[Must read] https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915
2. Important notes
1) [Course cancellation] Students must check that, for courses that require approval, they apply for course cancellation within the given period.
2) [Over-enrollment request] Students must understand the periods and procedures for each step: request, instructor approval, and registration confirmation.

3) [Overlapping course registration (중복수강신청, registering for courses with overlapping class times)] Apply in 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 수업 (Classes) > 중복수강신청 (Overlapping Course Registration) (refer to the manual), 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) – 9 Sep 2026 (Wed).

3) [Online classes for students on military leave] Students must request course registration changes themselves on 장병e음 (Jangbyeong E-eum, the online learning platform for military personnel) by 17 Sep 2026 (Thu).

4) [Change of course classification (교과구분변경, e.g. changing a course between major and elective categories)] Registration and approval of the change must be completed by 23 Sep 2026 (Wed), the point when 1/4 of the semester's class days have passed.
5) [Grading option for major courses of other departments] Students must apply themselves on mySNU by 23 Sep 2026 (Wed), the point when 1/4 of the semester's class days have passed.
